about: Taco Cam: own iPhone-as-USB-webcam app (Iriun-like, plus 0.5x) feeding OBS as the "Taco Cam" camera

runs.title: Team build, first iPhone build, first real-phone run
runs.summary: A nodeterm team built the iPhone app, PC engine and window; a follow-up session unblocked the push, did the checker review, built and installed the app and ran it on the real phone.

sessions.did: Settled choices with the user, wrote CONTRACT.md and the station briefs
Swift app, XcodeGen project, CI workflow, install guide; push refused (gh token lacked workflow scope)
Protocol, USB link, decoder, pipeline, virtual camera, fake phone; 185 tests; vcam verified bit-exact
tkinter control window, settings, README, launchers; 60 app tests

stages.name: Checker + real phone
stages.note: the Checker station never started; this session did its job

sessions.did: Swift review, 4 iOS fixes, first green build, IPA via iloader, real iPhone 11 working, 4K benchmark, Whatnot settings

events.text: Waiting for the user to grant the GitHub workflow permission

lessons: Check gh auth status for the workflow scope before a team run that must push a workflow file
Sideloadly login broken by Apple since 2026-10-21 (-80046); iloader works
OBS stream settings came from Whatnot's own tool: check where settings came from before suggesting changes
